Task Name: Fix: DB connection pool too small caused QueuePool timeouts cascading to dashboard/integration/all authed endpoints. Pool was 3+2 (=5/worker); on a single page load multiple authed requests (dashboard stats, users/me, notifications poll, integration settings) each check out a connection via get_current_user and queued past the 10s pool_timeout, throwing 'QueuePool limit ... connection timed out' (634 events on /notifications, /users/me in Sentry) which surfaced as generic 'could not load' errors. Postgres allows 60 connections via the Supabase transaction pooler and only ~10 were in use, so raised defaults to 10+10 (=20/worker, ~4x headroom, still <60 with 2 workers)
API Calls Count: No new API; affects all DB-backed endpoints via the shared async engine pool
Caching & Database Details: DB_POOL_SIZE 3->10, DB_MAX_OVERFLOW 2->10 (env-overridable). Connects via Supabase transaction pooler (pgbouncer :6543, statement cache off). No schema change
Security Controls / IDOR Prevention: No tenant-scoping change; pool sizing only, still env-driven to keep pool_size * workers * replicas <= 60

Task Name: Phase 3: Super-Admin RBAC parity sweep. Closed authorization gaps where sensitive endpoints were gated only by get_super_admin (any super-admin, incl. limited-tier employees) instead of the granular require_permission() that TAB_PERMISSIONS/DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS_BY_TIER already define. (1) commissions.py: POST/DELETE rules + POST ledger were mis-gated as superadmin.commissions.READ -> a read-only finance viewer could create/delete commission rules and inject ledger entries (financial manipulation); now require .write. (2) sessions.py: list + force-logout now require superadmin.sessions.read / .write (was any super-admin). (3) users.py: create_staybooker_employee (mints a SUPER_ADMIN) now master-admin only; create_hotel_user now requires superadmin.users.write and blocks creating SUPER_ADMIN unless master. (4) cache_mgmt.py: stats/keys -> cache.read, clear-hotel/flush-all -> cache.flush. (5) health.py: read -> health.read. (6) integrations.py: GET -> integrations.read, PUT -> integrations.write (handles API keys/secrets). (7) subscriptions.py: audit-logs -> audit.read, broadcasts GET -> broadcasts.read, broadcasts POST/PATCH/DELETE/publish-due -> broadcasts.write. (8) chains.py: list -> hotels.read, create/update/delete/add-property/link -> hotels.write. (9) bulk.py: bulk hotel actions -> hotels.write. (10) hotels.py: list_hotels -> hotels.read, update permissions/status + impersonate -> hotels.write, social-proof refresh -> hotels.read. Owner/master admins (perm '*') unaffected; all 327 tests still green.
API Calls Count: No new endpoints; tightened auth dependency on ~30 existing super-admin routes (commissions, sessions, users, cache, health, integrations, broadcasts, audit, chains, bulk, hotels, impersonate)
Caching & Database Details: No DB/schema change; no caching change
